description: Analyze compiled ELF binaries produced by GCC (S32Compiler 10.2/11.4). Identifies code size contributors, section layout, and symbol-level breakdown to diagnose large firmware and unexpected binary growth. Use when the user asks "why is my firmware so large", "which function takes the most flash", or "why did my binary grow".
